facts.claim: Chip ID register 0xD0 returns 0x60 for BME280 mass production devices.
SDO tied to GND selects 7-bit I2C address 1110110 (0x76); SDO tied to VDDIO selects 0x77. To select the I2C interface, CSB must be connected to VDDIO; SDO must not float.

Calibration dig_T1 is unsigned short; dig_T2 and dig_T3 are signed short. All stored as two 8-bit bytes with LSB at lower address (little-endian). Addresses: dig_T1 at 0x88/0x89, dig_T2 at 0x8A/0x8B, dig_T3 at 0x8C/0x8D.

Raw temperature is unsigned 20-bit: ut[19:12] at 0xFA (temp_msb), ut[11:4] at 0xFB (temp_lsb), ut[3:0] at 0xFC bits[7:4] (temp_xlsb). Temperature compensation formula input is the 20-bit unsigned value stored in a signed 32-bit integer.

The 32-bit integer temperature compensation computes var1 from adc_T, dig_T1 and dig_T2; for var2, it squares ((adc_T >> 4) - dig_T1), shifts that product right by 12, multiplies by dig_T3, then shifts right by 14. t_fine = var1 + var2; T = (t_fine * 5 + 128) >> 8, in units of 0.01 degrees Celsius. See the exact source formula.
mode[1:0] in ctrl_meas (0xF4) bits[1:0]: 00=sleep, 01 or 10=forced (one measurement then return to sleep), 11=normal.

status register 0xF3 bit3 = measuring[0]: set to 1 while conversion running, cleared when results transferred to data registers. Bit0 = im_update[0]: set to 1 when NVM data are being copied to image registers (at power-on-reset and before every conversion), cleared when done.
osrs_t[2:0] in ctrl_meas (0xF4) bits[7:5]: 000=skipped (output 0x80000), 001=oversampling x1, 010=x2, 011=x4, 100=x8, 101 and above=x16.
osrs_p[2:0] in ctrl_meas bits[4:2]: 000=skipped (output 0x80000), 001=x1 ... 101 and above=x16. Setting 000 skips pressure measurement.
osrs_h[2:0] in ctrl_hum (0xF2) bits[2:0]: 000=skipped (output 0x8000), 001=x1 ... 101 and above=x16. Changes to ctrl_hum only become effective after a write to ctrl_meas.
filter[2:0] in config register 0xF5 bits[4:2]: 000=filter off, 001=coefficient 2, 010=4, 011=8, 100 and above=16.

Measurement time formulas (ms): t_meas_typ = 1 + [2 * T_oversampling] (if osrs_t != 0) + [2 * P_oversampling + 0.5] (if osrs_p != 0) + [2 * H_oversampling + 0.5] (if osrs_h != 0); t_meas_max = 1.25 + [2.3 * T_oversampling] (if osrs_t != 0) + [2.3 * P_oversampling + 0.575] (if osrs_p != 0) + [2.3 * H_oversampling + 0.575] (if osrs_h != 0). For temperature x1 with pressure and humidity skipped: typical 3.0 ms; maximum 3.55 ms.

After power-on-reset the sensor is in sleep mode. In forced mode a single measurement is performed then the sensor returns to sleep mode. The forced mode must be selected again for each subsequent measurement.

policies_not_vendor_facts.timing_note: DRIFT policy: virtual_conversion_us=3600 is a deterministic fixture assumption slightly above the 3.55 ms Bosch maximum calculated for this selected profile (F12). Physical hardware has not been tested.

derived_candidates.derivation: Derived register settings from the cited Bosch bit fields for DRIFT’s selected fixture; these are project calculations, not Bosch-supplied configuration words.
derived_candidates.ctrl_meas_derivation: From Table 22 and Tables 24–25, printed p.29: osrs_t=001 in bits 7:5 gives 0x20; osrs_p=000 in bits 4:2 gives 0x00; forced mode=01 in bits 1:0 gives 0x01; combined ctrl_meas=0x21. Human reviewer confirms this calculation before approving.

model_limits: Temperature-only forced mode profile; pressure and humidity outputs not implemented
No SPI interface support in this profile
No electrical waveform or bus arbitration model
review_instructions: Human reviewer: compare F01–F13 and the selected profile against the cited printed pages of the hash-verified Bosch PDF. Check dig_T signedness, byte layout, the compensation shifts on p.25, forced timing (typical 3.0 ms; maximum 3.55 ms), and the derived ctrl_meas=0x21 bit fields on p.29. Only after that review, change status to reviewed and personally execute scripts/approve_contract.py. The 3600 us virtual conversion time is a DRIFT fixture policy, not a Bosch guarantee.
